sources.name: UgNLIS — Gulu Municipality cadastral parcels
sources.scope: Published parcel boundaries accessible through the Gulu Municipality selector (cad_mcp_gulu), Aswa county, Gulu cadastral district. Bounded partial coverage; modern Gulu City boundary conformity, citywide completeness and currentness are unestablished.
sources.attribution: Uganda Ministry of Lands, Housing & Urban Development — Uganda National Land Information System / NaLISEP
sources.licenceNote: No explicit open reuse licence identified on the checked official pages. Attribution retained; reuse permission needs confirmation.
caveats: Enumerates published block/plot selectors and serves their usable boundaries; complete query results describe this published selector scope, never citywide cadastral completeness.
Records without published geometry are counted and excluded from map results. Exact reads of such records report boundary unavailability.
Native numeric/UUID IDs are located by selector enumeration, then freshly re-read and checked against the native ID. No owner, address or title details are retained.
WGS84 coordinates use EPSG:21096 and Arc 1960 to WGS 84 (1), published accuracy 35 m; survey alignment and provider datum realization remain second-pass follow-ups.

The provider native CRS declaration and wire axes have not been independently verified. EPSG:21096 is the existing adapter assumption; no fitted offsets, geometry repair, clipping or rounding are applied.
